<noinclude>
Template for displaying personnel information in a standardized format.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Personnel
|name=Jane Smith
|role=Postdoc
|email=jane.smith@lab.edu
|start_date=2024-01-15
|status=Active
|supervisor=[[Personnel:John Doe]]
|certifications=[[Safety Certification:Biosafety Level 2]]; [[Safety Certification:Radiation Safety]]
|equipment_authorizations=[[Equipment:Confocal Microscope]]; [[Equipment:Centrifuge]]
|training_records=Completed cell culture training on 2024-02-01
}}
</pre>

== Parameters ==
* name - Personnel name (required)
* role - Role (PI, Postdoc, Graduate Student, etc.)
* email - Email address
* start_date - Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
* status - Status (Active, Inactive, Alumni)
* supervisor - Link to supervisor's personnel page
* certifications - Semicolon-separated list of certification links
* equipment_authorizations - Semicolon-separated list of equipment links
* training_records - Free text training information

[[Category:Template]]
</noinclude>
